overall: The AG found the Wayland School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to name the Children's Way and BASE nonunion personnel in its May 8 executive session notice, but declined to find intent.

allegations.summary: A complainant alleged the May 8 meeting notice's executive session topic failed to name specific nonunion personnel subject to negotiation discussion.
allegations.key_passage: we agree with the complainant that an executive session topic listed on the Committee's May 8 meeting notice failed to identify certain nonunion personnel who were the subject of this executive session discussion.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Publicly release the May 8 executive session minutes within 30 days of receipt of the determination.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. In addition, we order the Committee to publicly release its May 8 executive session minutes, within 30 days of receipt of this determination, in accordance with the guidance above.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
